paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
notes: Paper sets 90% CL upper limits on dark photon dark matter (kinetic mixing) and solar dark photons via single/few-electron S2-only analysis in XENON1T. Abstract confirms exclusion of new parameter space for dark photons. However, the provided paper content is truncated before Section VI (the results/limits section) and contains no numerical exclusion values or tables for the dark photon coupling vs mass. The paper also constrains DM-electron scattering, electric/magnetic dipole, and anapole interactions, but the bosonic dark matter (dark photon) result corresponds to the DarkPhoton coupling type. No extractable data points are available in the given content.
